chapter: Parisian Room and Bourbon Street clubs
title: Junior Dixielanders and Sunday afternoons at the Parisian Room
summary: Steinau went rarely to the Parisian Room Sunday concerts with Tony Almerico and heard several outfits.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: What about a band they call the Junior Dixielanders or the Dixieland Jubilee Junior Dixielanders up at the in the Parisian room do you remember any kids up there ever?
Teenagers? I believe I heard about it but I it seems to me I made a point of not going.
You didn't go when Tony Almarico was that much.
I went once I'm pretty sure but I didn't go when he was doing it Sunday after Sunday.
That was mostly back in 48 and 49 I would think.
When you heard Sharky there that was a different outfit entirely.
Well there were several different outfits that played. Yeah. I actually think as I remember Irving Fazola played at least on at least one of those
But they had names at least up there and you said you were impressed by Fazola.
